title: The loop keeps an install's public link on and says so when it cannot
description: Against a real control plane and a temporary Postgres, with a stub tailscale serving the install tailnet-only on 443 and one teammate invited: the loop runs tailscale funnel for 443, the install's own port; while Funnel is refused, Home shows one incident naming what the loop is doing and master status reads the same line, the command runs at most once per 10 minutes, and both clear once the link is public.

steps.name: Funnel restored on the install's port, incident appears and clears
